changelog: - **The marketing account spreadsheet can be imported, idempotently** (#2404, #2405, #2406, #2407 — story #2391, epic #2348). A written column contract ([`docs/marketing-import.md`](docs/marketing-import.md)) plus a sample file with its four edge cases (`scripts/fixtures/marketing-accounts-sample.csv`), and an importer that runs on the SHARED engine — `runImport({ parse, validate, resolve, apply })` and the shared delimited parser in `src/lib/importPreview.ts`, the same ones the roster feed uses. No second parser, no second dry-run engine, and no `if (dryRun)` branch in the planning path: a dry run is the same call with a writer that does not write, and `npm run import:marketing-accounts` is dry-run by default (`--apply` to write, `--owner=<email>` for the organisation and the default funnel owner, following `scripts/import-csv.mjs`'s flags). `Company` gains `vatId`, `country` (ISO-3166-1 alpha-2) with `@@unique([orgId, vatId])` — org-scoped, never global, because two tenants may each hold the same merchant — and `contactName`/`contactPhone` beside the existing `contactEmail`; all four nullable, so `db push` applies to populated tables. Matching is VAT id first, then `normalizeNameKey(name) + country` through the repo's existing normaliser, which transliterates İ/ı/ş/ğ/ü/ö/ç before lowercasing (a plain `toLowerCase()` makes `İstanbul Tekstil A.Ş.` and `ISTANBUL TEKSTIL A.S.` two accounts on every run), and it is batched — four queries per run, not four per row. Because both new columns arrive with this change, every account a tenant already holds has `vatId` and `country` NULL, so a blank country on **either** side falls back to the name alone when exactly one stored account bears it (and fills the country in as a gap, so the next run keys exactly); two same-named accounts in different countries and a row naming none is reported `SKIP` as ambiguous, never guessed. The in-file duplicate guard keys on the account a row **resolves to** rather than the identity it claims, so one merchant listed twice with the VAT filled in on only one line is one account. A bad row is reported as `{row, key, status:'ERROR', reason}` and never thrown; a second apply of the same file is all `UNCHANGED`. The data-model decision the rest of the backlog rests on is now written down in `docs/marketing-vertical/pipeline-record.md` and linked from that folder's README: account = `Company`, funnel record = `MentorshipRelation` (owner = `mentorId`, lead person = `menteeId`, account = `companyId`), lead person = a `MENTEE` `User` — no second pipeline carrier, and stage history stays `StatusChange` on the relation rather than a Company-level table. A row with a stage but no primary contact keeps its account and skips the stage with a warning, because a funnel record needs a person. The lead `User` a placed row mints is a record and not a login: password-less **and** on a generated stand-in address on `import.local` derived from the contact address and the org id, because the sentinel password alone is not the guarantee — `/api/auth/forgot` mails a reset link to any existing user and `/api/auth/reset` consumes it, so the merchant's real address would have made every imported contact a claimable MENTEE account. The real address stays on `Company.contactEmail`. The new `vatId`/`contactName`/`contactPhone` columns are stripped for non-ADMIN readers of `GET /api/companies` and `GET /api/companies/[id]` (`src/lib/companyVisibility.ts`) so this does not widen the broad company read tracked as #2431. `importErrorMessage()` in the shared engine now reports the first NON-empty line and the error code: Prisma formats every P2002/P2000/P2003 starting with a blank line, so every database-raised import failure was previously reported as ERROR with an empty reason — the roster feed inherits the fix. Unit-tested dependency-free with an in-memory writer (`npm run test:marketing-import`, 35 cases, `src/lib/marketingImport.ts` floored at 95%).

en: An account list kept in a spreadsheet can now be imported: companies, their VAT id, country and primary contact, and where each one sits in the funnel. It previews before it writes, and running the same file twice changes nothing.
tr: Elektronik tabloda tutulan müşteri listesi artık içe aktarılabiliyor: firmalar, vergi numarası, ülke ve birincil muhatap ile her birinin funnel'daki yeri. Yazmadan önce önizleme veriyor; aynı dosyayı ikinci kez çalıştırmak hiçbir şeyi değiştirmiyor.
de: Eine in einer Tabelle gepflegte Kundenliste lässt sich jetzt importieren: Firmen mit USt-IdNr., Land und Ansprechpartner sowie ihre Position im Funnel. Der Lauf zeigt erst eine Vorschau, und dieselbe Datei ein zweites Mal einzulesen ändert nichts.
